title: Global food waste in 2022 and SDG target 12.3

sources.title: World squanders over 1 billion meals a day - UN report (press release on the Food Waste Index Report 2024)
Goal 12: Ensure sustainable consumption and production patterns

facts.text: About 1.05 billion tonnes of food, including inedible parts, were wasted worldwide in 2022.
That amount equals 132 kilograms per person and almost one-fifth of the food available to consumers.
Of the food wasted in 2022, households were responsible for 60 percent, food services for 28 percent and retail for 12 percent.
SDG target 12.3 aims to halve per-person food waste at the retail and consumer levels by 2030.
